description: Memorial Day, 2026 5/25/26 Citizens! Today is Memorial Day here in the US, a day set aside for honoring our nation’s war dead, a worthwhile and solemn occasion. Its roots date back to the period after the Civil War, when communities placed flowers on the graves of those who died in that war, though it did not become a federal holiday until 1971.
